reasoning: Based on the evidence, as of early March 2026, the Celtics are 35-19 and half a game ahead of the Knicks in the Atlantic Division. The Knicks have a better head-to-head record (2-1) and division record (10-3 vs Celtics' implied ~10-4). The April 9 game against the Knicks is crucial - if Celtics lose, they likely lose the tiebreaker. The Celtics need to win remaining division games and the head-to-head to secure the division. Despite Tatum's absence, they've performed well but face a tight race. Given the close standings and tiebreaker disadvantage, I estimate roughly 55% probability.
